name: House of Alpine - Handcrafted Custom Wood Furniture
old_description: House of Alpine is a small Denver based custom furniture company committed to designing and producing elegant, solid wood furniture that will last for generations. With a natural eye for detail and an aptitude for perfection, House of Alpine is founded and lead by Mike Rudd, an Industrial designer turned furniture maker. From the hand selection of every piece of wood to the artisan craftsmanship of every furniture project, House of Alpine is your local provider of high quality, affordable custom furniture.
about:
House of Alpine operates from Englewood, Colorado, in the Denver metropolitan area. The company was founded by Mike Rudd, an industrial designer who relocated from Sydney, Australia, where he had previously grown a furniture business. Rudd established House of Alpine to bring his design sensibility—shaped by a love for nature and the Rocky Mountains—to the local market.

The shop specializes in custom solid-wood furniture, handling every step from hand-selecting lumber to final artisan craftsmanship. Each piece is built to order, with an emphasis on joinery and finish quality intended to last for generations. No facility size or headcount figures are published.

House of Alpine serves residential and commercial clients seeking made-to-measure furnishings. The company positions itself as a local provider of high-quality, affordable custom furniture, though specific industry verticals or named accounts are not disclosed.

Rudd’s background in industrial design and his experience scaling a furniture operation in Sydney inform the company’s approach: elegant, sophisticated, and simplistic designs that reflect the surrounding landscape. The founder describes the work as honest, passionate, and authentic, with a goal of creating furniture that endures a lifetime.
